title: Exclude passive reuse of every frozen P104 paid query in both orientations
body:
None of PR5580's **3,454 paid local requests** can be replaced from its complete prior history while preserving the requested value at the same event. The result covers the forward and complete bilinear-transpose words, every paid rank, unlimited retained values and free repeated-column native monomial decoding at every width f>=40. No new kappa is claimed.

[Scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1a4d30da7faf2c606e7852d6995023694e68388c/research/p104-complete-query-history/README.md), [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1a4d30da7faf2c606e7852d6995023694e68388c/research/p104-complete-query-history/PROOF.md), [exact checks](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1a4d30da7faf2c606e7852d6995023694e68388c/research/p104-complete-query-history/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1a4d30da7faf2c606e7852d6995023694e68388c/research/p104-complete-query-history/SOURCES.json), [registered replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1a4d30da7faf2c606e7852d6995023694e68388c/research/p104-complete-query-history/VERIFY.json). Base: canonical main `5e0052ca0aa3036a3afa8b0438927377c8d97d53`, priority revision 7. Contribution head: `1a4d30da7faf2c606e7852d6995023694e68388c`.

This answers the frozen-source test suggested by [PR5586 P1/P4/C1](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5586). Each orientation has 735 original inputs, 1,002 frame classes and 4,189 independent history rows. Every paid event strictly increases its destination-frame span. The credited pointwise Clifford theorem separates all other native monomial cosets, so this is more than a frame-label cache test. The scalar rows, contacts, chronology and required intermediate values stay fixed. Canonical coordination is [Discussion5595](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5595).

Registered Python 3.12 normal and optimized checks pass. Exact rational separating inputs cover every event; a separate modular pass uses opposite coordinate order and agrees on every frame dimension, paid count and endpoint. All scalar histories are explicitly included. The supplied witnesses also certify per-site squared relative ideal operator-error floors of 1/1,990,170 forward and 1/43,200 transposed. Early-query and duplicate-history controls check the availability boundary.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-complete-query-history
```

Python 3.12 and the standard library suffice. Committed-byte checks pass. Each ordinary native map is the repeated tensor lift of a fixed one-column affine/quadratic Clifford monomial. Different maps per column, general inter-column maps, nonlinear decoding, recursive-child internals and prior-caller observations are excluded. A changed continuation can fall outside this site-emulation result; the error floors do not bound the final multiplier after such a change. The pointwise theorem is credited, not re-audited here. Full caller, precision/tape/compiler and outer replays were not run. Full-history ancestry was not checked in the shallow checkout. Hosted status is unconfirmed at publication.

Credit Dugongue PR5586; the PR5526 pointwise theorem and its separate independent audit; classical linear transposition and PR5392; PR5590's frame binding; GamingPuzzled, DreamingOfClouds, thu-nmrc, Gareth Davidson, David Arias, Cinna Davis and the retained P104/native/Clifford/compiler authors. Source PR5580 is pinned at 6efa248cf456d6101d757e9d09ba29711d18a13a. Imported proof files and notices are unchanged.

Next: bind one changed paid argument or genuinely earlier caller observation, with its complete acquisition price. The active basis/contact and new-word searches remain separate. This result does not disprove PR5586's changed-source targets. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
